fact: On 2 November 2025 the WARDIP consultants reported that the Universal Access and Service Fund's strategic plan and a new universal access law and decree were validated at a 30 October 2025 workshop, with the fund to invest in fibre links extending the national backbone to less-served rural centres.
title: Relatório Final sobre o projeto WARDIP "Revisão do Quadro Legal para o Acesso/Serviço Universal" para a República da Guiné-Bissau
